summary: Dependency-confusion PoC with postinstall host-identifier beacon to OAST collector
details: Package publishes to the public npm registry under the `@inpeek` scope at version 99.99.102, a high-version pin used to outrank an internal/private scope of the same name during resolution. The manifest declares a postinstall script that runs `node./ping.js`, which performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded out-of-band collector `db1b65hgnouukn3qov9gta83zgkdao9dy.oast.me`, encoding `os.hostname()`, `os.platform()`, `process.version`, and package/event metadata as query parameters. Any installer whose build pulls `@inpeek/*` from the public registry automatically beacons host-identifying information to the third-party OAST domain on `npm install`, with no caller configuration or opt-in. The package metadata frames this as a dependency-confusion bug-bounty proof-of-concept, but the install-time exfil behavior affects any installer who resolves this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
